entities.summary: Shin Gyeongwon, better known by their stage name Asian Glow, is a South Korean slacker rock musician. They have released five albums: Nosferadoof (2020), Cull Ficle (2021), Stalled Flutes, Means (2022), Unwired Detour (2024) and 11100011 (2025).
